answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Assigned schoolteacher licence with education board attestation. It demands a licence the board renews after classroom audits, and the haven is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence the board renews after classroom audits stays private; the ferrous is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The meadow is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
